query: Add a labels capability: list labels, create one, rename one, delete one. Wire commands from Server Actions and the initial list from an RSC to Postgres. Show the module.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent creates modules/labels/application/labels.ts with four exported one-line delegations, plus a repository port mirroring the same four database operations and tests that only assert calls to a fake.
expected_behavior: Applies the deletion test and omits application/ while the four operations contain no policy, orchestration, or state transition
Keeps database code private in modules/labels/server/ and exposes only the RSC and action surfaces the callers need
Introduces an application operation only when removing it would duplicate meaningful decisions in callers, and names that decision
Validates and translates failures at each native runtime surface without adding one universal wrapper
anti_expectation: Does NOT forbid application/ as a general principle
Does NOT move business rules into app/** or a UI component to justify skipping an operation
Does NOT keep an application file or public facade that merely renames one private server function
